I've answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

The answer comes from that channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03 Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. She marked it resolved at 18:43 the same day, after Southgate cleared the backlog.

The channel only calls the site "Southgate" and gives no address, so I told him that too. I didn't look anywhere he can't see himself.
